title: No central headquarters, a virtual serial machine

statements.text: There is no single definitive stream of consciousness because there is no central headquarters. Specialist circuits work in parallel and create multiple drafts, some of which are promoted to further roles by a virtual machine in the brain, whose seriality is the upshot of coalitions of specialists. Culture, through memes borne mostly by language, shapes the brain into a mind.

sources.quote: There is no single, definitive "stream of consciousness," because there is no central Head-quarters
